gaps.explanation: The whole gap is the 911 Wireless Service Holding Fund 2,812. Schedule 5 Budgetary Comparison Schedule - Special Revenue Funds - Nonmajor Funds (p15) prints it under RECEIPTS as 'Transfers in' 2,812, and detail records it that way (detail index 119, section other financing, +2,812). The Schedule 6 nonmajor combining schedule (p17, 911 Wireless Service Holding column: Intergovernmental 2,812, Transfers in (out) blank) and Exhibit D (p4, Intergovernmental 2,191,170 in the Total column) print the same money as an Intergovernmental receipt; no fund prints a matching 2,812 transfer out. So the schedule classes it as a transfer, the statement as revenue: detail revenue 8,501,725 + 2,812 = 8,504,537 = statement total receipts (p4). Detail follows Schedule 5 as printed (already listed in the report's decision_needed); if the user rules it a receipt, replace detail index 119 with an Intergovernmental 2,812 line (fund '911 Wireless Service Holding Fund', p17, category intergovernmental/state aid), which closes the gap exactly. No fix written.
